description: This file defines structures, functions, and constants related to 'bins' used for slab allocations in jemalloc, including bin info, bin management, and statistics merging.

classes.name: bin_info_t
classes.description: Stores read-only information about each bin size class, including region size, slab size, number of regions, number of shards, and bitmap info.

classes.name: bin_t
classes.description: Represents a bin used for slab allocations, containing a lock, current slab pointer, heaps for non-full slabs, list of full slabs, and statistics.

classes.name: bins_t
classes.description: A set of sharded bins of the same size class, containing a pointer to bin shards.

methods.name: bin_shard_sizes_boot
methods.description: Initializes the shard sizes for each bin.

methods.name: bin_update_shard_size
methods.description: Updates the shard size configuration for bins.

methods.name: bin_boot
methods.description: Initializes bin data structures with given shard sizes.

methods.name: bin_init
methods.description: Initializes a bin to an empty state, returning true on error.

methods.name: bin_prefork
methods.description: Prepares a bin for a fork operation.

methods.name: bin_postfork_parent
methods.description: Handles post-fork operations for the parent process.

methods.name: bin_postfork_child
methods.description: Handles post-fork operations for the child process.

methods.name: bin_stats_merge
methods.description: Merges statistics from a bin into a destination stats structure, locking the bin during the process.
